notes: Five reference cluster centers per variant come directly from the accepted AI594 LOD0 layouts. Values are normalized within exterior-card corner bounds, with Blender Z up; layout basis axes are columns. Preserve the low interior cluster as well as the four peripheral clusters.

Measured exterior crown bounds XYZ in metres: mature_01 min [-2.01309,-1.93503,0.12435], max [2.07633,2.19054,2.71759]; mature_02 min [-2.63383,-2.02121,0.07469], max [2.82453,2.41295,3.27683]; mature_03 min [-3.35077,-1.71551,-0.00771], max [2.79744,1.97907,2.40208]. These are card corner bounds, not opaque foliage bounds.

Reference patch counts by cluster are [830,441,619,447,435], [1015,681,383,752,445], and [987,565,736,932,560]. The low interior cluster is dense; equal density or equal height across the five clusters would change the shrub form.

Use three intersecting double-sided wood silhouette panels for LOD3, totaling six wood triangles. Each captures the actual multi-stem shrub rather than a solid replacement bole. A horizontal intersection of the accepted wood mesh at 0.20 m contains 11, 13, and 13 disconnected stem loops for mature_01, mature_02, and mature_03; preserve their independent ground contacts and transparent gaps. The trunk ring and tip fields are inactive when lod3WoodMode is panels.

At 0.50 m the wood cross-sections contain 11, 13, and 17 separate loops, confirming the strong spreading and low branching of mature_03. At 0.04 m some basal flares join and yield 7, 9, and 8 loops. These are measured cross-section components, not botanical stem counts.

Thirty LOD3 foliage triangles allow five clusters of three double-sided two-triangle panels. Panel scales are preferred spans; fit each assigned source partition with a margin so edge shoots are retained. Bake source silhouette, twig organization, density and holes rather than uniformly distributing individual leaves across the rectangle.

Mature_01 is nearly circular in plan: 4.089 by 4.126 m. Mature_02 is taller and asymmetric, with its highest reference cluster at positive Y and 2.267 m above ground. Mature_03 is a strongly flattened, spreading shrub: 6.148 by 3.695 m in plan, exterior-card height 2.410 m, and two separated extreme X lobes. Do not reuse one common spherical crown for all three variants.

At the primary 2.2 m bus eye height, the shrub crown is seen more from above than the tall tree crowns. Use moderate panel tilts and inspect the low center for top-view holes; mature_03 needs the maximum allowed 15-degree tilt. Also inspect perpendicular views because its X span is 1.66 times its Y span.

Review azimuth -72 degrees is measured from Blender +X toward +Y and matches the previous comparison direction. Additional azimuths must confirm that crossed panels do not collapse, that the near-ground canopy remains irregular, and that alpha edges do not create an opaque hedge skirt.

LOD4 uses at most three wood and three foliage panels, six triangles per category. LOD5 uses a single two-triangle wood silhouette and single two-triangle foliage silhouette aligned as one flat billboard. Alpha must keep the visible stem gaps and the broad species outline.

LOD6 is one combined two-triangle plate for ten staggered shrub instances, drawn from all three variants with explicit source positions. Use the tighter shrub spacing factor without making a solid horizontal hedge; retain uneven peaks and occasional gaps. Two group triangles amortize to 0.2 total triangles per source instance and are below both category ceilings.
